translations.web: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.
translations.bsb: So the pride of man will be brought low, and the loftiness of men will be humbled; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day,
translations.kjv: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
translations.asv: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.
